# A verbatim ssh key keeps its comment in sesam.yml, while the audit log records
# it without one. The two must still be recognised as the same key, or the key
# shows up as a diff forever.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin

# Declare bob with a key as pasted from his id_ed25519.pub.
cp declared.yml sesam.yml
envsubst sesam.yml
exec sesam config apply
stdout 'told bob into dev'

# Applied, so in sync - the comment is not a difference.
exec sesam config diff
! stdout .
exec sesam config apply
! stdout .

# Removing the key via the CLI (which passes the recorded, comment-less form)
# still finds the commented entry in sesam.yml.
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient age1tdy2pxsfwpxxe0c9cuwty8zpsv6uuhf4zyug5f9lfl982lh3tctqrw2ll7
exec sesam user remove-recipient --user bob --recipient 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton+aQGCo+e3c/DPpR6qXCZwBNlh15Aqwua74O/SFA'
! grep 'bob@laptop' sesam.yml
exec sesam config diff
! stdout .

-- declared.yml --
users:
  - name: admin
    key:
      - $ADMIN_PUBKEY
  - name: bob
    key:
      - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGton+aQGCo+e3c/DPpR6qXCZwBNlh15Aqwua74O/SFA bob@laptop

groups:
  admin:
    - admin
  dev:
    - bob

secrets: []
